# netactuate_vpc_backend_templates (Data Source)

Reads VPC Backend Templates visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_vpc_backend_templates" "example" {
  vpc_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vpc_id` (Number) VPC ID whose backend templates will be listed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `templates` (List of Object) List of backend templates attached to the VPC (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `backend_hosts` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--templates--backend_hosts))
- `backend_template_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)

<a id="nestedobjatt--templates--backend_hosts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates.backend_hosts`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `backend_host_id` (Number)
- `internal_address` (String)
- `name` (String)
